import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('magaza.db')
c = conn.cursor()
# Tablo yapıları
for t in ['musteriler','urunler','siparisler','siparis_kalemleri','iadeler']:
    print(f'--- {t} ---')
    for row in c.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({t})'):
        print(row)
# Örnek veriler
print('\n--- urunler ---')
for row in c.execute('SELECT * FROM urunler'):
    print(row)
print('\n--- siparisler (2025) ---')
for row in c.execute("SELECT * FROM siparisler WHERE tarih LIKE '2025%'")
    print(row)
print('\n--- siparis_kalemleri ---')
for row in c.execute('SELECT * FROM siparis_kalemleri'):
    print(row)
print('\n--- iadeler ---')
for row in c.execute('SELECT * FROM iadeler'):
    print(row)
conn.close()
